meta.name: The Raikar Case
meta.description: An edge-of-the-seat thriller about family, love, deceit, and the secrets that wrench us apart. It grapples with the dilemma of 'Will You Choose Truth Over Family?', and if trust can ever really be absolute.

videos.title: Suicide... or a murder?
videos.overview: A seemingly put-together affluent family comes under police scrutiny when its youngest member commits suicide. The Naik Raikars put up a brave front until a message from beyond the grave threatens to break the family apart.
